reason: A fragment of a seed count with its container: 'seeds 1-2 per pod', '3-6-seeded' (pod). The counted part is seed (PO_0009010) and the container is legume fruit (PO_0030100, synonym 'pod') or follicle fruit (PO_0030105, also synonym 'pod'), pattern 03. 'per pod' is not a structure, the same as 'per node' and 'per pinna' last time.

The margin of the spathe limb (FLOPO_0986048, added last review). It is the existing class with the region 'margin' (flora_context_words region margin); its colour ('violet at margin', 'whitish margins') is a quality of that region. No class is needed.

A proportion of a part's length over which it is connate, divided or toothed ('connate 3/5-2/3 their lengths', 'soudés sur 1/5-2/5 de leur longueur'). This is the extent of a quality, like 'fraction' rejected last time, not a structure.

target: catkin inflorescence (PO_0030119) with bearer quality female (PATO_0000383)
reason: A narrower name for catkin inflorescence (PO_0030119, synonyms ament, catkin). Pattern 04 expresses it: 'pistillate' is a reviewed bearer_quality in flora_context_words.tsv mapped to female (PATO_0000383), and 'catkin' is among the bearers allowed for it. The counts ('clusters of 2-7') are counts of catkins.

The arrangement of ovules or seeds within a locule ('seeds in 2 rows per locule', '2-4 rangées d'ovules par loge'). A row is a series (seriation), not a structure. The parts are seed (PO_0009010) or ovule, held in plant ovary locule (PO_0025266) or fruit locule (PO_0025270). It is like 'seeds per locule' and 'seriate' last time.

'segment' was rejected last time as a generic part that needs its organ. The stalk of a segment ('leaving persistent stalk', 'dark color', 0.6-1.5 mm) cannot be placed without knowing whether the segment is a leaf segment, a perianth segment or a fruit article. stalk (PO_0025066) alone would lose the whole it belongs to.

An adjective fragment of 'antheridial buds' or 'antheridial branch' (moss perigonia). The structure behind it is antheridium (PO_0025125) or a male branch or bud, which the tokenizer should take as a phrase. The word alone is not a part.
An adverb from 'closely set' or 'closely spaced'. It is a degree of the spacing of the counted pinnae or leaflets, not a structure.

A texture or structure quality of a root system, tunic or sheath remnants ('fibrous root cluster', 'remnant fibrous sheaths'). The bearers are root system (PO_0025025), tunic (FLOPO_0986041) and similar. It is not a part.

label: petal blade
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009032 (petal)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the expanded, usually flattened distal portion of a petal (PO:0009032), above the claw when a claw is present.
reason: Several floras use it, mainly for clawed petals (Caryophyllaceae, Brassicaceae, Malpighiaceae), and give the blade its own length, width, shape and lobing ('blade 3-4 x 1.5-2 mm', 'lame profondément bilobée'). Annotating these on petal (PO_0009032) would give the wrong length when a claw is present. PO has petal apex, base, margin and spur, and leaf lamina (PO_0020039) for the leaf, but no petal lamina. Propose it to PO upstream alongside the existing petal parts.

label: phyllary green zone
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009045 (involucral bract)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the herbaceous, chlorophyll-bearing region of an involucral bract (PO:0009045), usually distal, set off from its pale, indurate or scarious basal and marginal parts.
reason: A standard diagnostic character in Asteraceae (especially Astereae, e.g. Symphyotrichum, Erigeron). The zone has its own shape ('green zones lanceolate to linear') and presence ('not evident') that differ from the shape of the whole phyllary, so it cannot go on involucral bract (PO_0009045). The region patterns only cover apex, base, margin and upper or lower part. It is narrow and family-specific, so keep it in FLOPO and do not propose it to PO.

A quality word (stipitate). The examples measure the stipe itself, and 'stipe' already has a rule to stalk (PO_0025066, C264). Like 'beaked', 'clawed' and 'pedicellate' last time, it names no structure.

A row is an arrangement of the counted parts, not a structure ('2 or 3 rows of areoles', '25 rangées'). It is the same as 'rows per locule'. The part itself, areole, was rejected last time because it is ambiguous (cactus areole vs leaf lamina areole PO_0025392). Counts of rows are seriation, which pattern 03 does not split.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) part of non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075), region base
reason: In moss descriptions these are the cells at the base of the phyllid ('basal cells hyaline, quadrate to short-rectangular'). They are expressible as plant cell (PO_0009002) with container non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075, synonym phyllid) at the region base. 'basal' here is the region of the leaf, not a series position of the cell, so pattern 04's basal (FLOPO_0991002) is not the reading.

'segment' is a generic part (rejected last review, as were 'terminal segment', 'lateral segment' and 'basal lobe'). The basal segments of a leaf, a pinna or a perianth cannot be told apart without the organ.
A shape modifier ('broadly triangular', 'broadly ovate'). The counted parts are lobes, leaflets or teeth. It is a degree of a quality, not a structure.
A quality (visibility or prominence) of leaf scars, midvein, lenticels or hilum. Like 'prominent' last time, it is not a structure.
A positional quality ('median row of large cells', 'median chlorocysts'). Some examples are elliptic fragments ('2 median distinct') whose part is elsewhere in the sentence. It is not a structure.
A texture quality of a sheath or membrane ('membranous sheath', 'gaines membraneuses'). The bearer is the sheath. It is not a part.

Narrower: veins that run parallel in a bract, glume, sepal or monocot leaf. vein is an exact synonym of vascular bundle (PO_0005020), as in the earlier rules for nerve and nervure. 'parallel' is a quality of the veins and can be kept as one. Where the organ is a leaf, the bearer is leaf lamina vein (PO_0020138).

A fragment of 'vascular bundle' ('base with 4 vascular bundles' in fern stipes). That phrase is already vascular bundle (PO_0005020); the fix is to take the two words as one term. The adjective alone is not a part.

In ferns, the lobe or pinnule on the side of a pinna that faces its base. 'lobe' is a generic part (rejected last review). The examples mix lobes of pinnae with basiscopic pinnules ('1-3 basiscopical pinnules'), and no pattern covers the basiscopic or acroscopic position. A class for it would be doubtful.

target: corolla lobe (FLOPO_0986006), region apex (plant organ apex FLOPO_0985023 part of corolla lobe)
reason: The apex of an existing FLOPO class, with the region 'apex' from flora_context_words. 'apex obtuse', 'emarginate' and 'rounded' are shape qualities of that region.

Narrower: the main veins of a leaf or bract, e.g. the palmate basal nerves ('principal nerves 9', '5-6 principal nerves on each side'). Whether midvein, secondary or palmate primary is meant varies with the flora, so the common parent is used, the same as the nerve and nervure rules. On a leaf, leaf lamina vein (PO_0020138) is the more specific bearer. Counts 'on each side' stay held (count_per_position).
A quality (elevated or prominent) of the counted veins or glands ('8-10 raised veins'). It is not a structure.
A generic region ('forming a zone', '2 zones glanduleuses latérales'). It needs the organ and the kind of zone, the same as band, spot and layer last review.

The second term of a ratio ('awn 1-2 times the length of the lemma', 'palea 1 length of lemma'). This is pattern 10, ratio to another part, with the lemma as the other part. It is a fragment like 'times calyx' last time.

The plural of 'areole', rejected last review as ambiguous. It may be the spine-bearing cushion of a cactus or a mesh of the leaf venation, leaf lamina areole (PO_0025392). 'without areoles' and 'areoles 0.3-2.0 mm' do not tell which.
A growth form, a quality of the whole plant or colony ('in loose or dense mats', mat-forming), not a part.
An adjective fragment ('of 1 row of cells', 'formées de cellules'). The part is plant cell (PO_0009002) or the cell layer of the organ in the sentence. The word names no structure.
